name: PyStruct
tagline: A Python-inspired language runtime written in TypeScript, from tokenizer to evaluator, with a browser IDE that shows the AST, the execution steps and the variable table as code runs.
overview: PyStruct is a Python-inspired programming language runtime written in TypeScript. It includes a tokenizer, recursive descent parser, AST representation, evaluator, lexical scoping, typed variables/functions, Python-style arithmetic and boolean semantics, built-ins such as print and type, property-based tests, and a browser-based IDE/playground.
